senses.d: to believe something is true without having proof
senses.e: I assumed he was coming, but he never arrived.
senses.ep: فرض کردم می‌آید، اما هرگز نرسید.

senses.d: to plan or want to do something
senses.e: We intend to extend the house next year.
senses.ep: قصد داریم سال بعد خانه را بزرگ‌تر کنیم.

senses.d: able to be trusted to work well or behave well
senses.e: She is a very reliable colleague.
senses.ep: او همکاری بسیار قابل اعتماد است.

senses.d: large or important enough to have an effect
senses.e: There was a significant change in her mood.
senses.ep: تغییر قابل توجهی در حالِ او بود.

senses.d: lasting for only a short time
senses.e: This is only a temporary solution.
senses.ep: این فقط یک راه‌حل موقت است.

senses.d: an advantage that something gives you
senses.e: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
senses.ep: ورزش منظم فواید سلامتی زیادی دارد.

senses.d: to show clearly that something is true or how something works
to give special importance or attention to something
senses.e: She emphasized the need for regular practice.
senses.ep: بر نیاز به تمرین منظم تأکید کرد.

senses.d: to keep something in good condition or keep it going
to get something you want, especially with effort
senses.e: You must obtain permission before entering.
senses.ep: قبل از ورود باید اجازه بگیری.

senses.d: to limit the size, amount, or range of something
senses.e: The new law restricts the sale of cigarettes.
senses.ep: قانون جدید فروش سیگار را محدود می‌کند.

senses.d: to happen or start to exist
senses.e: Problems may arise during the project.
senses.ep: شاید در طول پروژه مشکلاتی پیش بیاید.
